description: The best way to assess if you’re on track to reach your goals throughout the year is by comparing measurable data across different categories. Visualize multivariate data on a 360-degree and know your directionality, size, strengths, and weaknesses by projecting your Multivariate data in a single view with xViz Radar/Polar chart. xViz Radar/Polar Chart is perfect for analyzing and comparing product performance across multiple variables such as functionality, aesthetics, and durability. The Radial Chart type is similar to the column/bar chart, with the exception that the data is shown in a detailed radial format rather than columns. This functionality assists users in reaching conclusions by quickly addressing differences in projected data across different categories. Key Feature Highlights: Supports 3 chart options – Radar, Polar & Radial series 10+ series options – column, spline, lollipop, stacked, area charts and more! Interactive Legends – limit the number of category members that can be seen at once to focus on just a few Axis Scaling – manually specify the scale limitations by turning off the 'Auto Axis Min/ Max' option Axis formatting – customize colors, font size, line width and other attributes of axis and value labels Conditional Formatting – highlight outliers based on set rules, to gain insights on your data Summary Table – gain a tabular overview to slice and…
